exercises.name: Bodyweight Squats
exercises.description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Lower your body by bending knees and hips as if sitting in a chair. Keep chest up and drive through heels to return to start.

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.description: Step forward with one leg, lowering your body until both knees are bent 90 degrees. Push through front heel to return to starting position.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlifts
exercises.description: Stand with feet hip-width apart. Hinge at hips while keeping back straight, lowering weight down legs. Feel stretch in hamstrings, then drive hips forward to return.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.description: Sit in leg press machine with feet on platform at shoulder width. Lower weight by bending knees to 90 degrees, then push back up.

exercises.name: Leg Curls
exercises.description: Lie face down on leg curl machine. Curl weight up by bending knees, squeeze hamstrings at top, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Leg Extensions
exercises.description: Sit in leg extension machine. Extend legs straight out, squeeze quads at top, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.description: Stand with feet hip-width apart. Rise up onto toes, squeeze calves at top, lower back down with control.

exercises.name: Pistol Squats
exercises.description: Stand on one leg with other leg extended. Squat down on one leg as low as possible. Requires significant balance and strength.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squats
exercises.description: Place one foot elevated behind you on a bench. Squat down on front leg, keeping torso upright. Great for single-leg strength.

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.description: Step up onto a platform or bench with one leg, drive through that leg to stand, then step back down. Alternate legs.

exercises.name: Goblet Squats
exercises.description: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest level. Squat down with elbows inside knees. Excellent form for learning proper squat mechanics.

exercises.name: Wall Sits
exercises.description: Lean against a wall with feet out. Slide down until knees are at 90 degrees. Hold position without moving. Intense isometric exercise.

exercises.name: Jump Squats
exercises.description: Squat down, then explosively jump as high as possible. Land softly and immediately descend into next squat. Builds power and explosiveness.

exercises.name: Sissy Squats
exercises.description: Hold support and lean back while bending knees. Creates intense quad stretch and activation. Very challenging.

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Raises
exercises.description: On leg press machine, position toes on lower part of platform. Push with calves while keeping knees straight. Isolates calves.

exercises.name: Box Jumps
exercises.description: Jump onto an elevated box with both feet. Step down. Builds explosive power and leg strength.

exercises.name: Leg Circles
exercises.description: Stand on one leg and make large circles with the other leg. Great for hip mobility and balance.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Deadlifts
exercises.description: Stand on one leg, hinge forward at hips while extending non-standing leg behind. Return to start. Challenges balance and hamstring strength.

exercises.name: Adductor Machine
exercises.description: Sit in adductor machine with legs apart. Press inner thighs together by squeezing adductors. Targets inner thigh muscles.

exercises.name: Abductor Machine
exercises.description: Sit in abductor machine with legs together. Push legs apart using outer thigh muscles. Targets outer thigh and hip abductors.

exercises.name: Hack Squats
exercises.description: Stand in hack squat machine with back on pad. Lower by bending knees while keeping torso upright. Great quad focus.

exercises.name: Floor Leg Raises
exercises.description: Lie on back, keep one leg straight on floor. Raise other leg to 90 degrees, lower without touching ground. Targets hip flexors.

exercises.name: Glute Bridges
exercises.description: Lie on back with knees bent and feet flat. Push through heels to lift hips, squeeze glutes at top, lower with control.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridges
exercises.description: Lie on back with one knee bent, other leg extended. Push up with working leg to lift hips. Intense glute activation.

warmups.name: Leg Swings
warmups.description: Hold support and swing one leg forward and back in a controlled manner. Increases hip mobility and circulation.

warmups.name: Hip Circles
warmups.description: Stand on one leg and make large circles with the other knee. Warms up hip joint and improves mobility.

warmups.name: Knee to Chest
warmups.description: Walk forward while pulling one knee up to chest level. Activates hip flexors and core.

warmups.name: Walking Quad Stretch
warmups.description: Walk while pulling heel toward glute. Dynamic quad stretch that maintains movement.

warmups.name: Walking Calf Stretch
warmups.description: Walk with toes elevated off ground, walking on heels. Stretches calves and ankle flexors.

warmups.name: Internal Hip Rotation
warmups.description: Stand and rotate hip/knee internally then externally. Prepares hip joint for lateral movements.

warmups.name: Frankenstein Walks
warmups.description: Walk forward while kicking one leg straight up in front. Dynamic hamstring and hip flexor activation.

warmups.name: Butt Kickers
warmups.description: Run in place while kicking heels up to glutes. Increases heart rate and activates hamstrings.

warmups.name: High Knees
warmups.description: Run in place lifting knees up high. Elevates heart rate and activates hip flexors and core.

warmups.name: Lunge with Twist
warmups.description: Step into lunge then rotate torso toward front leg. Combines lower body prep with core and mobility work.

warmups.name: Bodyweight Squat Hold
warmups.description: Hold a deep squat position with good form. Prepares muscles and joints for squatting movements.

warmups.name: Glute Activation Band Exercises
warmups.description: Wear resistance band around legs. Perform abduction, external rotation, and kickbacks to activate glutes.

stretches.name: Quad Stretch
stretches.description: Stand on one leg and pull other foot toward glute. Keep knees together for maximum quad stretch.

stretches.name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
stretches.description: Place one leg on elevated surface and hinge at hips. Keep back straight and feel hamstring stretch.

stretches.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
stretches.description: Step one leg back into lunge position. Push hips forward to stretch hip flexors of back leg.

stretches.name: Wall Calf Stretch
stretches.description: Place one foot on wall with toes elevated. Keep heel on ground and lean forward to stretch calf.

stretches.name: Piriformis Stretch
stretches.description: Lie on back and cross one ankle over opposite knee. Pull knee toward chest to stretch piriformis (deep glute muscle).

stretches.name: Butterfly Stretch
stretches.description: Sit with soles of feet together and knees out to sides. Gently press knees toward ground with elbows.

stretches.name: IT Band Stretch
stretches.description: Cross one leg over standing leg and lean away. Feel stretch on outside of hip and thigh.

stretches.name: Lying Quad Stretch
stretches.description: Lie on side and pull top foot toward glute. Feel quad stretch while lying down.

stretches.name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
stretches.description: Lie on back and pull knee toward chest with straight leg. Intense hamstring stretch in comfortable position.

stretches.name: 90/90 Stretch
stretches.description: Sit with both knees at 90 degrees. Front leg tests hip external rotation, back leg tests hip internal rotation.

cooldowns.name: Light Walking
cooldowns.description: Walk at easy pace to bring heart rate down gradually. Great for recovery after intense leg workout.

cooldowns.name: Child's Pose
cooldowns.description: Kneel and sit hips back to heels with arms extended. Relaxing stretch for hips, glutes, and lower back.

cooldowns.name: Supine Spinal Twist
cooldowns.description: Lie on back and pull one knee across body toward opposite shoulder. Gently stretches hip and lower back.

cooldowns.name: Foam Roll Quads
cooldowns.description: Use foam roller on quads to relieve tension and increase blood flow. Helps with muscle recovery.

cooldowns.name: Foam Roll Hamstrings
cooldowns.description: Use foam roller on hamstrings for recovery and tension release. Excellent post-workout cooldown.

cooldowns.name: Deep Breathing
cooldowns.description: Sit or lie comfortably and take slow, deep breaths. Activates parasympathetic nervous system for recovery.

cooldowns.name: Standing Quad Stretch
cooldowns.description: Stand on one leg and gently pull foot toward glute. Extended hold for deep quad stretch during cooldown.

cooldowns.name: Downward Dog
cooldowns.description: Push hips up forming inverted V shape. Stretches hamstrings, calves, shoulders, and spine.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.description: Place hands shoulder-width apart. Lower body by bending elbows until chest nearly touches ground. Push back up.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.description: Use parallel bars or bench. Lower body by bending elbows, then push back up. Excellent triceps and chest exercise.

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.description: Hang from bar with shoulders wide apart. Pull body up until chin clears bar. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Chin-ups
exercises.description: Hang from bar with palms facing you. Pull up until chin clears bar. More bicep emphasis than pull-ups.

exercises.name: Barbell Curls
exercises.description: Hold barbell with shoulder-width grip. Curl weight up by bending elbows, squeeze biceps, lower with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curls
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells at sides. Curl both up simultaneously, squeeze at top, lower with control.

exercises.name: Hammer Curls
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells with neutral grip (palms facing in). Curl up like hammering motion. Targets brachialis muscle.

exercises.name: Tricep Rope Press
exercises.description: Hold rope attachment on cable machine. Press down by extending arms, squeeze triceps, let rope come back up.

exercises.name: Tricep Extensions
exercises.description: Hold weight above head with both hands. Lower weight behind head by bending elbows, extend back up.

exercises.name: Close Grip Bench Press
exercises.description: Bench press with hands closer than shoulder width. Greater tricep and inner chest activation.

exercises.name: Preacher Curls
exercises.description: Sit at preacher curl bench with arms over pad. Curl weight up, squeeze biceps, lower with control.

exercises.name: Concentration Curls
exercises.description: Sit and rest one elbow on knee. Curl dumbbell up using only bicep. Intense bicep isolation.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curls
exercises.description: Lie on incline bench and curl dumbbells. Extended range of motion emphasizes long head of biceps.

exercises.name: Cable Flyes
exercises.description: Set cables at shoulder height. Pull handles together in arc motion across body. Great for chest definition.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-ups
exercises.description: Push-up position with hands forming diamond shape under chest. Intense tricep and inner chest focus.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck Flyes
exercises.description: Sit at machine facing pad. Pull handles back in arc motion, squeeze shoulder blades, control return.

exercises.name: Lateral Raises
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells at sides. Raise arms out to sides up to shoulder height, lower with control.

exercises.name: Military Press
exercises.description: Hold barbell at shoulder height. Press straight up until arms extended, lower with control.

warmups.name: Arm Circles
warmups.description: Extend arms out to sides and make large circles forward then backward. Warms up shoulder joint.

warmups.name: Shoulder Rolls
warmups.description: Lift shoulders to ears then roll backward and forward. Improves shoulder mobility and circulation.

warmups.name: Band Pull-Aparts
warmups.description: Hold resistance band at chest level. Pull band apart by opening arms wide, squeeze shoulder blades.

warmups.name: Band Shoulder Press
warmups.description: Stand on resistance band. Press hands overhead using band tension. Activates shoulders safely.

warmups.name: External Rotation with Band
warmups.description: Hold band and rotate shoulder externally against resistance. Warms up rotator cuff.

warmups.name: Walking Push-ups
warmups.description: Walk forward while alternating single-arm push-ups. Dynamic shoulder and chest activation.

warmups.name: Scapular Push-ups
warmups.description: In push-up position, squeeze shoulder blades together and pull chest up slightly without bending elbows. Activates scapula.

stretches.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
stretches.description: Pull one arm across chest to opposite shoulder. Feel stretch in rear shoulder and upper back.

stretches.name: Overhead Tricep Stretch
stretches.description: Reach one arm overhead and bend elbow, gently pull elbow back with other hand.

stretches.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
stretches.description: Place arm on doorframe. Step forward through door to stretch chest and front shoulder.

stretches.name: Reverse Prayer Stretch
stretches.description: Hands behind back in prayer position. Straighten arms and lift hands up to stretch shoulders and chest.

stretches.name: Sleeper Stretch
stretches.description: Lie on side and pull opposite arm across body toward ground. Stretches rear shoulder and back.

cooldowns.name: Walking with Arm Swings
cooldowns.description: Walk at easy pace while swinging arms gently. Brings heart rate down and relaxes shoulders.

cooldowns.name: Shoulder Relaxation Hold
cooldowns.description: Sit comfortably and gently roll shoulders backward. Focus on relaxing tension in shoulders and neck.

cooldowns.name: Static Cross-Body Stretch
cooldowns.description: Extended hold of cross-body shoulder stretch. Deeper stretch during cooldown phase.

exercises.name: Pull-ups - Back Focus
exercises.description: Wide grip pull-ups emphasizing back muscles. Pull elbows down and back to engage lats.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Barbell Rows
exercises.description: Hold barbell at shoulder width. Hinge at hips keeping back straight. Row weight to chest, squeeze shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rows
exercises.description: Support body with one knee on bench. Row dumbbell up to hip, squeeze back muscle, lower with control.

exercises.name: Cable Rows
exercises.description: Sit at cable machine. Pull handle to torso squeezing back muscles. Good control due to cable resistance.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldowns
exercises.description: Sit at pulldown machine. Pull bar down to chest by driving elbows down, squeeze lats.

exercises.name: Inverted Rows
exercises.description: Hang under bar at angle. Pull chest to bar keeping body straight. Great back exercise with less equipment.

exercises.name: Back Extensions
exercises.description: Face down on back extension machine. Hinge at hips and extend backward, squeeze lower back.

exercises.name: Supermans
exercises.description: Lie face down. Lift arms and legs simultaneously, squeeze back muscles, lower with control.

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.description: Use rope attachment on cable machine at face height. Pull rope toward face separating rope ends. Targets rear shoulders and upper back.

exercises.name: Seal Rows (Decline Bench)
exercises.description: Lie on decline bench and row dumbbells. Isolates back without leg drive.

exercises.name: Machine Rows
exercises.description: Sit at row machine. Pull handles toward torso with controlled motion. Safe back exercise.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlifts
exercises.description: Stand inside trap bar. Deadlift up focusing on back muscles. Great full back and posterior chain exercise.

warmups.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
warmups.description: On hands and knees, alternate arching back (cow) and rounding spine (cat). Improves spine mobility.

warmups.name: Band Pull-Aparts
warmups.description: Hold resistance band at chest. Pull band apart by opening arms, squeeze shoulder blades.

warmups.name: World's Greatest Stretch
warmups.description: Lunge forward, twist toward front leg, then push-up position. Dynamic full-body back and hip warmup.

warmups.name: Dead Bug
warmups.description: Lie on back with arms and legs up. Lower opposite arm and leg while keeping back on ground. Back and core warmup.

stretches.name: Child's Pose
stretches.description: Kneel and sit hips back to heels with arms extended. Stretches entire back and shoulders.

stretches.name: Cat Pose Stretch
stretches.description: On hands and knees, round spine pushing chest toward ground. Stretches entire back.

stretches.name: Downward Dog
stretches.description: Form inverted V with body. Stretches entire back, hamstrings, and calves.

stretches.name: Thoracic Rotation Stretch
stretches.description: Lie on side with knees bent. Rotate top arm over body opening up thoracic spine.

stretches.name: Back Bend Stretch
stretches.description: Stand and place hands on lower back. Arch backward gently to stretch front of body and extend back.

cooldowns.name: Light Walking
cooldowns.description: Easy paced walking to bring heart rate down after intense back workout.

cooldowns.name: Extended Child's Pose
cooldowns.description: Longer hold of child's pose to deeply relax back muscles during cooldown.

cooldowns.name: Lying Spinal Twist
cooldowns.description: Lie on back and pull knees to chest then cross over body. Relaxing back and spine stretch.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press

exercises.name: Dumbbell Flyes
exercises.description: Lie on bench with dumbbells extended over chest. Lower in arc with slight elbow bend, bring back together.

exercises.name: Landmine Press

warmups.name: Band Pull-Aparts

stretches.name: Reverse Prayer Stretch

stretches.name: Lying Chest Stretch
stretches.description: Lie on back on floor or bench. Let chest open up naturally. Deep relaxing chest stretch.

stretches.name: Cross-Body Chest Stretch
stretches.description: Pull one arm across chest toward opposite shoulder. Stretches chest and shoulder.

cooldowns.name: Doorway Stretch Hold
cooldowns.description: Extended doorway stretch for longer chest relaxation during cooldown.

stretches.name: Standing Quad Stretch
stretches.description: Stand on one leg pulling foot toward glute to stretch quadriceps after cardio.

stretches.name: Hamstring Stretch
stretches.description: Place one leg on elevated surface. Hinge forward stretching hamstring.

stretches.name: Calf Stretch
stretches.description: Place foot on wall with toes up. Lean forward stretching calf muscle.

stretches.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
stretches.description: Step back into lunge position. Push hips forward stretching hip flexors.

cooldowns.name: Walking Cool-down
cooldowns.description: Easy walking gradually bringing heart rate down after intense cardio.

cooldowns.name: Deep Breathing
cooldowns.description: Sit or lie down taking slow, deep breaths. Activates parasympathetic nervous system for recovery.

cooldowns.name: Foam Rolling Legs
cooldowns.description: Light foam rolling of legs after cardio to aid recovery and release tension.
